desc_lfm_artist: Hailu Mergia is an Ethiopian keyboardist, accordionist, composer, and arranger based in Washington, D.C., United States. He is best known for his work with the Walias Band during the 1970s, a group regarded as one of the most influential in Ethiopia’s musical golden age.
